steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Types of graphs: Different equations produce different shaped graphs. Being able to recognise these shapes is essential.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What shape is the graph of y = x³ - 2x? | Where are the asymptotes on y = 2 ⁄ x ? | What point does y = 3 x pass through?

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: Match each equation to its graph description: (i) y = x³ - 3x, (ii) y = 4 ⁄ x , (iii) y = 3 x , (iv) y = sin x.
